gaps.sentence: The demonstrators were ___ from entering the building.
gaps.explanation: 'prevent somebody FROM doing' — passive: were prevented from entering.

gaps.sentence: The more you practise, ___ easier it becomes.
gaps.explanation: 'The more … the easier …' — both halves take 'the'.

gaps.sentence: They had no ___ but to call the police.
The letters ___ delivered every morning at eight.
He prefers cycling ___ driving to work.
It's the first time I've ___ eaten oysters.
gaps.explanation: 'The first time + present perfect + ever' emphasises novelty.

gaps.sentence: The findings will be published in ___ course.
gaps.hint: in ___ course = at the right time
gaps.explanation: 'In due course' = eventually, when the time is right.
